DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>: Path to an AutomationTools constants Python file. Each file is a selectable test group.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.Tests: List of pipelines to validate in the selected constants file.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.Tests[].pipeline: Exact pipeline name from that file's PIPELINE_STATES dictionary.
DESCRIPTION.RUN_TESTS: Loads selected pipelines, checks their functions, phases, arguments, results and static dependencies. Does not execute automation steps.
